Multiple rectangles/squares at once

shape_rectangles.Rd

shape_rectangles()/shape_squares() are vectorized versions of shape_rectangle()/shape_square(): each argument may be a vector, recycled against the others via purrr::pmap()'s own vctrs-based rules (any length-1 element is broadcast to the common length; mismatched lengths greater than 1 raise an error). The result is a sketch containing one shape_rectangle()/shape_square() per recycled row, rather than a single drawable.

Usage

shape_rectangles(
  x = 0,
  y = 0,
  width = 1,
  height = 1,
  trans = trans_identity(),
  ...
)

shape_squares(x = 0, y = 0, side = 1, trans = trans_identity(), ...)

Arguments

x, y

Centroid coordinates. Default 0.

width, height

Rectangle dimensions. Must be non-negative. Default 1.

trans

A trans object applied to the shape's computed points. Default trans_identity() (no transform).

...

Arguments passed to style().

side

Side length, for shape_square(). Must be non-negative. Default 1.

Value

A sketch.

See also

Other 2D shapes: shape_bezier(), shape_bezier_ribbon(), shape_bezier_ribbons(), shape_beziers(), shape_blob(), shape_blobs(), shape_circle(), shape_circles(), shape_ellipse(), shape_ellipses(), shape_polygon(), shape_polygons(), shape_raw(), shape_raws(), shape_rectangle(), shape_ribbon(), shape_ribbons(), shape_twist(), shape_twists(), shape_wedge(), shape_wedges()

Examples

draw(shape_rectangles(x = 1:3, width = c(0.5, 1, 1.5), height = 0.5))

draw(shape_squares(x = 1:3, side = c(0.5, 1, 1.5)))
